description: This file contains utility functions and classes for AWS Transcribe WebSocket streaming, including presigned URL generation, event message building, and event decoding.

classes.name: AWSTranscribePresignedURL
classes.description: Handles AWS Signature Version 4 signing process to create presigned WebSocket URLs for streaming transcription.

methods.name: get_presigned_url
methods.description: Creates a presigned URL for AWS Transcribe streaming with configurable parameters.

methods.name: get_request_url
methods.description: Generates a presigned WebSocket URL with AWS Signature V4 authentication.

methods.name: get_headers
methods.description: Builds a header following AWS event stream format, encoding header name and value.

methods.name: build_event_message
methods.description: Constructs a properly formatted AWS event stream message containing audio data.

methods.name: decode_event
methods.description: Decodes an AWS event stream message, verifying CRCs and extracting headers and payload.
